source_snapshot.test_set: Intel CPU RAS -Correctable Patrol Scrub Error
source_snapshot.procedure: Enable EDKII injection controls, deploy ITP, boot Windows, log/halt, inspect mc.dimminfo(), inject rank-0 CE with immConsume=True and PatrolConsume=True, resume and collect results/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Normal operation, slot-specific correctable event in BMC and optional UEFI, both fault indicators off, and Cscript explicitly identifies Patrol Scrub Error.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; FAE/operator performs injection and agent tails patrol/scrub/corrected plus BMC SEL evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED; adds controller attribution, explicit flag validation and Patrol Scrub output, bounded injections, indicators, recovery and restoration.
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled 2. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 3. Boot SUT into Windows. 4. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 5. Using following command >>>itp.log("C:\Test.log") >>>halt() >>>mc.dimminfo() >>>ei.injectMemError(socket, channel, dimm, sub_channel,rank=0, errType="ce", immConsume=True, PatrolConsume=True) >>>go 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log should record which slot has DIMM correctable error 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. Corresponding DIMM lightpath will not light if there is one 5. uEFI SEL Log should record which slot has a DIMM correctable error if there is one 6. Cscript log should indicate it's a Patrol Scrub Error.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Memory controller 1~N (Intel Patrol Scrub on Memory controller 1~N error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'patrol|scrub|sddc|corrected|CE_'; echo __Patrol_Scrub_on_Memory_controller_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

test_case.test_name: Memory controller 1~N — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Cause a correctable memory error to be consumed through the patrol-scrub path on each approved memory controller, prove the Intel harness labels it Patrol Scrub, correlate the correct physical slot across OS/BMC/UEFI and confirm normal operation with both fault indicators off.
required_package: Supported ITP/CScripts build/hash and authoritative immConsume/PatrolConsume interaction
Per-controller/rank coverage matrix and bounded injection count
Exact Cscript Patrol Scrub string/fields and authoritative Windows/BMC/UEFI slot oracle
Indicator applicability, recovery and restoration checklist
test_case.test_command: An FAE/operator maps each controller to a DIMM tuple, verifies how `immConsume=True` interacts with `PatrolConsume=True`, enables the approved BIOS settings and performs one injection per target. The full Cscript transcript must demonstrate patrol-scrub consumption, while read-only evidence confirms slot attribution, no-light behavior, health and restored settings.
test_case.expected_result: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log should record which slot has DIMM correctable error 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. Corresponding DIMM lightpath will not light if there is one 5. uEFI SEL Log should record which slot has a DIMM correctable error if there is one 6. Cscript log should indicate it's a Patrol Scrub Error.
